changed_precondition.detail: The missing EA identity blocker recorded on 2026-09-12 was repaired by governed registry commit d8bc40d0c3dde0c324229bd2ce7f03bb44232f37. Identity, slug, source_id and four active magic tuples now agree with the approved card.

warnings: EA_PERF_UNGATED_BAR_DATA for CopyRates at source line 377; upstream OnTick has a new-bar gate, so this requires explicit reviewer-safe structure or annotation rather than silent acceptance

verification.detail: All four H4 backtest setfiles use RISK_FIXED=1000 and RISK_PERCENT=0.
All four setfile headers still contain build_hash: pending.

findings.detail: The source receives c_price but anchors the stop beyond d_price. The approved structural invalidation is beyond the C pivot by 0.5 ATR, subject to the 3.5 ATR distance cap.
The independent +1.5 ATR break-even trigger is absent. Break-even is incorrectly coupled to the C-D 50% partial-profit target.
Strategy_ExitSignal implements only the time stop and never closes on a new opposite-direction 5-0 completion.
A news blackout returns before partial-profit, break-even and time-stop handling. Mandatory news blackout must suppress entries without suspending risk-reducing management of an existing position.

On restart, g_active_tp1_price and g_tp1_done are reset and are not reconstructed for an existing position, disabling the approved partial-profit and break-even management or allowing a repeated partial close.

Cooldown starts when the entry signal is generated, applies to both directions, and can expire while the trade remains open. The card requires no same-direction re-entry for 12 H4 bars after the prior trade.
The deterministic build guard rejects two unapproved raw series calls and the missing QM_FrameworkTrackOpenPositionMae hook.
SPEC.md is absent and every setfile build_hash is pending. The old source build artifact predates the governed identity repair and explicitly generated no setfiles; it is not fresh closure evidence.

disposition: Leave the Gemini review task in REVIEW. Repair card fidelity and restart-safe management, add SPEC/tests, bind the setfiles, then compile only through the governed COMPILE_EA path and return fresh evidence to Codex. Do not enqueue a pipeline phase from this review.
result_line: RESULT: NEEDS_REWORK — registry precondition repaired, but structural-stop, exit, management, restart-state, build-guard, SPEC and setfile-binding gates remain open.
